card.name: Single-agent and monotherapy wording
card.fires_on: The word completing "single agent" or "monotherapy" (the "agent" after "single", or "otherapy" after "Mon") when a drug is described as used alone, in drug-label dosing and trial sections.

modes.label: Single agent
modes.description: The word "agent" after "as a single" when a drug is given alone.
modes.example: Across clinical trials of pazopanib tablets as a single<< agent>>, ALT > 3 x ULN

modes.label: Monotherapy
modes.description: The ending "otherapy" of "Monotherapy" used as a heading or label for use of one drug alone.
modes.example: Patients with CLL/SLL Receiving VENCLEXTA in Combination with Obinutuzumab, with Rituximab or as Mon<<otherapy>> Adverse Reaction Occurrence Dosage Modification

card.plain: It marks the point where a label says a drug is used alone rather than combined with others.
